title: Obi-Wan Kenobi
franchise: Star Wars: Attack of the Clones
description: After an attempt on Senator Amidala's life, Obi-Wan Kenobi was tasked with discovering the identity of the assassin. That simple task led Obi-Wan on an investigation across the galaxy, from learning of the clone army on Kamino, to discovering the Separatists and their Droid foundries on Geonosis. Captured by Count Dooku, Obi-Wan was ambushed and sentenced to death but survived.
